fills.name: Berserker
fills.quote: 31:15 75 食物，40 黄金，22 秒生产时间 / 75, 40 gold, 22 second production time.
fills.note: The stated cost is food and gold only, so wood is 0.
fills.verdictReason: The page never states a wood cost for the Berserker. The 0 is inferred from the omission. The English line '75, 40 gold' leaves the first resource unnamed, and 69:36 says 'That costs 75, 45, 40 / 75, 40', so a zero wood cost is not established.

fills.name: Berserker
fills.quote: 64:57 15 点伤害 / Veteran Berserkers, right here, 15 damage.
fills.note: Becomes 16 with the +2 attack upgrade, per the next line.
fills.verdictReason: 64:57 says 'Veteran Berserkers ... 15 damage', but 64:59 adds 'So 16 when you complete the plus two attack', and 59:24 notes the +1 infantry attack research had already finished. The page's own context shows the 15 includes the +1 attack upgrade, so it is not the Veteran base value. The page gives no base number.

fills.quote: 71:09 They cost 7530, but what's the difference in stats?
fills.verdictReason: The page only says '它们的价格是7530 / They cost 7530' (also 64:03 '7530 is the cost'). It does not name the resources and never states a wood cost of 0.

fills.name: Skâne Crossbowman
fills.variant: Imperial, observed with a +2 damage blacksmith upgrade
fills.quote: 70:57 造成11点伤害，对重甲单位额外增加10点伤害，并且它们也能吃食物 / 11 damage plus 10 versus heavy and they can also eat the food.
fills.note: At 71:27: 'Plus 2 damage, that's from the upgrade.' loueMT 10:49 says that in Castle they deal 3 less bonus vs heavy and have 5 less HP than a normal crossbowman.
fills.verdictReason: 70:57 does state '11 damage plus 10 versus heavy', and 71:27 says 'Plus 2 damage, that's from the upgrade'. The tier is wrong, though: the game was in Castle Age. The Castle landmark Gullinn Temple was chosen at 61:53 and the Imperial cathedral was only built at 77:26. Also, the page never names the unit Skane.

fills.name: Longship
fills.quote: 4:03 300 HP. | 4:05 它们的成本是 80 和 150 / And they cost 80, 150.
fills.note: Beasty reads the Viking archer ship (Longship) without units. loueMT (BV1dSny6uE4j 4:40) says 弓手船花费80肉 | 150亩 (亩 = 木, wood), the same as a regular archer ship. So food 80 / wood 150 is likely, but check the unit types.
fills.verdictReason: Subtitle 4:05 only says 'And they cost 80, 150' for the archer ship and names no resources. Food is a guess (ships usually cost wood and gold). The page gives no food value.

fills.name: Northern Migration
fills.quote: 22:07 How long is the villager queue? | 22:12 22秒 / 22 seconds.
fills.note: Beasty then wonders if it is 23. Corvinus (BV1Lvn46dEbY 72:17) says one villager every 22 seconds. loueMT says 2 s slower than a normal villager. Falkr's Village saga reduces it to 20 s (Beasty p1 53:00).
fills.verdictReason: The streamer is guessing. At 22:12 he says '22 seconds', then 22:21 'is it 23?', 22:23 'It doesn't say here', 22:33 'I think it's 20', 22:35 'I think it's 22, but whatever'. The page states no interval, and 'Northern Migration' is never named.

fills.name: Longhouse attachment: Farmstead
fills.quote: 37:20 啊，这些要花 20 秒，那些要花 2 秒 / Ah, these take 20 seconds and these take 2 seconds.
fills.note: loueMT 1:07: 只需要两秒就可以立即生成两片蔬菜田.
fills.verdictReason: 37:14 'let's upgrade these B-Skips', 37:20 '这些要花 20 秒，那些要花 2 秒 / these take 20 seconds and these take 2 seconds'. The page never says which attachment takes 2 s. Assigning 2 s to Farmstead is an inference.
